info.title: Straits.live premium data
info.description: Machine-payable Strait of Hormuz crisis data for AI agents: the live-AIS vessel manifest, single-vessel multi-body sanctions dossiers (OFAC + UK), a shadow-fleet risk screen of the vessels active on AIS in the Persian Gulf window, a flag rollup, bunker & marine-fuel prices, a modeled war-risk transit premium nowcast, full-resolution history, bulk export, a one-call situation snapshot, the complete daily brief, real-time streaming, and threshold-alert webhooks. Settled per request in USDC on Base over the x402 protocol; no key, no account.
info.x-guidance: Fourteen operations: twelve priced per request ($0.01-$0.50), plus two free ones (GET /api/premium/stream, which a session token authenticates, and DELETE /api/premium/webhooks/{id}, which the subscription secret authenticates). Most are GET; POST /api/premium/stream/session and POST /api/premium/webhooks take a JSON body. An unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with a machine-readable x402 challenge; sign the USDC authorization and retry (x402-capable clients such as @x402/fetch handle this automatically). Every route except the stream is rate limited to 30 requests per 60 seconds per client IP, one sliding window shared across all of them. Start with GET /api/premium/snapshot for the whole dashboard state in one call. GET /api/premium/history/{feed} serves full-resolution time series (feeds: index-5min, transits, stranded, ais-gaps); GET /api/premium/export bundles every series in one archive. GET /api/premium/vessel/{imo} returns one vessel dossier; GET /api/premium/hormuz/risk-screen ranks the whole live vessel population worst-first with per-hull risk reasons and sanctions matches; GET /api/premium/hormuz/flags rolls it up by flag state; GET /api/premium/bunker returns current bunker & marine-fuel prices with the Fujairah premium over Singapore and Rotterdam; GET /api/premium/risk-premium returns a live modeled war-risk transit premium (Nx over the peace baseline, 1x-80x scale) with the standing straits.live insurance-estimate multiple as a static reference. Ten of these products are also exposed as paid MCP tools at https://straits.live/api/mcp. A free tier lives at https://straits.live/status and /api/v1/* with summary counts and shorter history windows on some series; human documentation, including an exact free-vs-premium comparison, at https://straits.live/api.

get.summary: Historical series: stranded and AIS-gap counts (hourly, capped at one year, growing), 5-min index, daily transits

parameters.name: feed
parameters.description: index-5min: both Hormuz indices at 5-minute cadence. transits: complete daily IMF PortWatch history, enriched per day with the 7-day moving average, pre-crisis-baseline deviation, and reopening-threshold headroom. stranded: hourly stranded-vessel counts, up to a year. ais-gaps: hourly AIS-dark counts, up to a year.

200.description: Historical series; the body varies by feed

truncated.description: True when the read hit its ceiling, so older rows exist that this call did not return. Always false for index-5min, which reads only the requested window.

days.description: index-5min only: the window actually served, 1-30

crisisPressure.description: index-5min only: Crisis Pressure series at 5-minute cadence

escalationForecast.description: index-5min only: Escalation Forecast series at 5-minute cadence

points.description: transits, stranded and ais-gaps only; index-5min carries crisisPressure and escalationForecast instead. transits rows add ma7, baselineDelta and thresholdHeadroom to each PortWatch day; stranded rows are hourly total/anchored/stopped/transit/stranded.

baseline.description: transits only: the frozen pre-crisis daily baseline

reopeningThreshold.description: transits only: the 7-day-MA level the reopening markets resolve on

basis.description: stranded only: how the counts were measured after basisChangedAt

basisChangedAt.description: stranded only: date of the latest series break. Do not difference across it. The latest (2026-09-26) moved vessels with an hour-old AIS fix out of the counts, stepping stranded down about 30%; the one before (2026-07-30) stepped counts up about 3.4x on total.

get.summary: Open the real-time Server-Sent Events stream with a token bought at POST /api/premium/stream/session

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The session token. May be sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> instead; one of the two is required.

200.description: SSE stream. A tick event every ~10s carries oil (brent, wti, change24h, stale, updatedAt) and both index readings (value, band); a change event carries each new change-log entry; an end event with reason session_expired closes the stream at the token expiry. Comment lines keep the connection warm through a read fault.

401.description: Missing, malformed, or expired session token

confidence.description: 0-1; degrades when driver feeds are stale/missing or escalation-market volume is thin

drivers.description: Per-driver score, raw value, health, and weight: throughput, escalation, ovx, event

degraded.description: Drivers that were stale or missing and dropped out of the estimate
